units.source_text: 且说二条院西殿里，侍女渐渐地多起来。

en.t: Meanwhile, in the west wing of Nijo-in, the number of serving women gradually increased.

units.source_text: 陪伴紫儿游戏的童女和幼孩，看见这一对主人都很漂亮，都很时髦，

en.t: The young girls and children who played with Zi'er saw that both of their masters were beautiful and stylish,

units.source_text: 大家很高兴，无心无思地在那里游戏。

en.t: and everyone was delighted, playing there without a care in the world.

units.source_text: 源氏公子不在家时，寂寞之夜，紫儿想起了外婆，不免啼哭。

en.t: When Prince Genji was away from home, on lonely nights, Zi'er would think of her grandmother and could not help crying.

units.source_text: 但她并不怎么想念父亲。

en.t: But she did not miss her father very much.

units.source_text: 原来她从小不亲近父亲，并无可恋。

en.t: After all, she had never been close to her father since childhood, so there was little for her to long for.

units.source_text: 现在她只是亲近这个后父似的源氏公子，镇日缠住他。

en.t: Now she was close only to Prince Genji, who was like a stepfather to her, and clung to him all day long.

units.source_text: 每逢源氏公子从外面回来，她总是首先出去迎接，

en.t: Whenever Prince Genji returned from outside, she was always the first to go out and welcome him,

units.source_text: 亲切地向他问长问短，投身在他怀里，毫无顾忌，毫不识羞。

en.t: warmly asking him all sorts of questions and throwing herself into his arms, with no reserve and no sense of shyness.

units.source_text: 这真是一种异乎寻常的爱情！

en.t: This was truly an extraordinary kind of affection!
